label: Unknown / unclassified
notes: Fallback when classifier cannot decide; always gated.

label: Consumer electronics
notes: Phones, chargers, headphones, audio.

label: IT / telecommunication equipment
notes: Routers, laptops, peripherals.

label: Electrical tools
notes: Drills, screwdrivers, garden tools with motors.

label: Lighting equipment
notes: LED bulbs, lamps, fixtures.

label: Medical devices (low risk)
notes: Thermometers, blood pressure monitors.

label: Portable batteries
notes: AA, AAA, lithium coin cells, power banks (BattG).

label: Industrial batteries
notes: E-bike packs, UPS battery banks.

label: Toys (3+ years)
notes: GPSR + Toy Safety Directive; always gated.

label: Textiles / apparel
notes: Clothing without electronic components.

label: Kitchen utensils
notes: Spatulas, ladles, whisks, non-electric hand tools.

label: Kitchen small appliances
notes: Toasters, kettles, blenders, electric small household devices.

label: Large kitchen appliances
notes: Ovens, dishwashers, large household appliances.

label: Cookware
notes: Pots, pans, baking trays without electronics.

label: Furniture
notes: Tables, chairs, shelving without electronic components.

label: Garden tools (non-electric)
notes: Spades, rakes, secateurs, manual hand tools.

label: Garden machinery (electric)
notes: Electric mowers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers.

label: Sporting goods
notes: Balls, rackets, fitness equipment without electronics.

label: Bicycles
notes: Non-electric bicycles and components.

label: Books / media
notes: Printed books, magazines, physical media.

label: Cosmetics
notes: Make-up, skincare; EU Cosmetics Regulation applies.

label: Personal care
notes: Soaps, shampoos, hygiene products.

label: Food contact items
notes: Food packaging and utensils in direct food contact.

label: Baby products (non-toy)
notes: Strollers, cots, feeding items; not toys.

label: Pet products
notes: Pet accessories, bowls, leashes without electronics.

label: Office supplies
notes: Folders, binders, desk organisers.

label: Stationery
notes: Pens, paper, notebooks.

label: Jewellery
notes: Rings, necklaces, earrings without electronics.

label: Watches
notes: Analogue/quartz watches; smartwatches classed as consumer electronics.

label: Bags / luggage
notes: Handbags, backpacks, suitcases without electronics.

label: Shoes
notes: Footwear without electronic components.
